How TTMS powers Asset Tracking

Operationally practical capabilities inspired by modern fleet technology teams and tailored for transport businesses.

  • Single inventory record for owned, leased, and customer assets
  • Asset movement timeline with custody checkpoints
  • Geo-fence and inactivity alerts for misplaced equipment
  • Service scheduling for tools and powered support devices
  • Asset assignment workflows linked to dispatch and route plans
  • Cost and replacement reporting to support procurement decisions

User Safety & Care

We care for customers, drivers, and owners by turning day-to-day fleet execution into safer, clearer, and less stressful workflows.

  • Field teams spend less time searching for gear in active yards
  • Critical safety equipment remains inspected and available
  • Driver workload drops when handoff data is accurate and complete
  • Customers benefit from reliable equipment readiness at pickup

Audit & Compliance Reporting

Asset Tracking data feeds TTMS reporting automatically so teams can prepare regulator-facing and owner-facing reviews with less manual effort.

  • Asset Tracking events are captured with timestamps and operational context for cleaner audit trails.
  • ELD, AI DashCam, and GPS records support compliance reporting without fragmented manual collection.
  • Owners can review KPI, exception, and safety logs in one TTMS - Total Transport Management System workflow.
  • Teams generate regulator-ready and customer-facing reports with accurate, centralized data.
